acts.title: Induction at Blade Grove
acts.summary: Take the Captain oath. Cut the first Null tendril. Learn each tribe’s edge.

acts.title: District Fracture
acts.summary: Null Bloom cracks Registry, Cloud, Works, Radio, and Bazaar. Re-anchor each.

acts.title: Null Bloom Heart
acts.summary: Push into the bloom’s core. Synergy boards. Stamp the airdrop queue.

nodes.title: Captain’s Oath
nodes.speaker: Circuit Sohei
nodes.lore: The Root Circuit under bonsaios.app is fraying. You swear the Captain oath: prune Null before it hollows Registry, Cloud, Works, Radio, and Bazaar. One Ashigaru scout waits beyond the neon torii.
nodes.boardHint: Recruit from the dock. One Warden is enough to learn the ring.

nodes.title: Null Scout
nodes.speaker: Chrome Ashigaru
nodes.lore: Null Bloom does not announce itself with fireworks. It sends hollow copies that look almost right. Cut the scout pair before they map the grove’s lanes.
nodes.boardHint: Two enemies. Fill two board slots if you can.

nodes.title: Ronin Edge
nodes.speaker: Root Ronin
nodes.lore: Ronin sever tendrils at first contact — the same doctrine that keeps Bazaar trades honest. A Captain blade waits to test your flare timing.
nodes.boardHint: blade_flare chips the next enemy after a strike.

nodes.title: Veil Lesson
nodes.speaker: Neon Kunoichi
nodes.lore: Registry identities ghost when Null peels the veil. Kunoichi survive one lethal and slip intel home. Learn neon_veil before the Districts crack.
nodes.boardHint: Two Kunoichi. Expect a second life on the first lethal.

nodes.title: Circuit Ward
nodes.speaker: Circuit Sohei
nodes.lore: Cloud vaults stay sealed only while Sohei wards hold. circuit_guard hardens the line — Null wants those seals soft.
nodes.boardHint: Three Sohei-leaning foes. Bring HP or finish fast.

nodes.title: Root Bind Drill
nodes.speaker: Data Yamabushi
nodes.lore: Works is where creators root files into the vault. Yamabushi bind retaliators so craft is not answered with Null’s counterfeit strikes.
nodes.boardHint: root_bind can skip retaliation. Watch ROOT thresholds.

nodes.title: Grove Gate
nodes.speaker: Chrome Ashigaru
nodes.lore: Ashigaru hold the broadcast ring. Clear the Gate and the Circuit issues your first free pack ticket — grind fuel, not a cash gate.
nodes.boardHint: Four foes. Synergies matter. Spend Sap on refresh if the dock is thin.

nodes.title: Registry Fracture
nodes.speaker: Neon Kunoichi
nodes.lore: Profiles flicker. Null Bloom is minting hollow principals. Re-anchor Registry with Kunoichi doctrine — survive, report, cut.
nodes.boardHint: Legend pressure. Veil and follow-ups.

nodes.title: Cloud Bleed
nodes.speaker: Circuit Sohei
nodes.lore: Sovereign media vaults weep counterfeit roots. Sohei re-seal Cloud before Null reads what users stored.
nodes.boardHint: Stacked wards. Bring burst or binds.

nodes.title: Works Hollow
nodes.speaker: Data Yamabushi
nodes.lore: Drafts and stages desync from the vault. Bind the retaliators. Keep creative roots alive.
nodes.boardHint: Mix of binds and a Sohei legend.

nodes.title: Radio Static
nodes.speaker: Chrome Ashigaru
nodes.lore: Signal drops to Null hiss. Ashigaru volleys clear the ring so Radio stays a public root, not a hollow feed.
nodes.boardHint: Volley chips. Spread damage.

nodes.title: Bazaar Spoof
nodes.speaker: Root Ronin
nodes.lore: Counterfeit listings bloom. Ronin flare the fakes so Bazaar NFT trade stays sovereign — not a Null mirror market.
nodes.boardHint: Legend Ronin. Flare chains hurt.

nodes.title: Crosswire Ambush
nodes.speaker: Neon Kunoichi
nodes.lore: Pillars are re-anchored but Null mixes tribes on one board. Read synergies. Do not fight each blade as if it were alone.
nodes.boardHint: Mixed tribes — expect layered keywords.

nodes.title: Fracture Seal
nodes.speaker: Circuit Sohei
nodes.lore: Seal the District fracture. The Circuit issues another pack ticket. Paid packs remain optional acceleration — this clear is free.
nodes.boardHint: Four strong pieces. Spend Sap wisely.

nodes.title: Bloom Threshold
nodes.speaker: Root Ronin
nodes.lore: Beyond the sealed Districts: the bloom’s edge. Hollow legends stand where living Wardens should.
nodes.boardHint: Three legends. Full board preferred.

nodes.title: Mirror Grove
nodes.speaker: Neon Kunoichi
nodes.lore: Null mirrors your roster’s silhouette. Veil dancers lead. Cut the copies before they learn your tells.
nodes.boardHint: Kunoichi wall. Force through veils.

nodes.title: Sealbreak Choir
nodes.speaker: Circuit Sohei
nodes.lore: Sohei hollows chant broken seals. Restore the ward or Cloud vaults open to noise.
nodes.boardHint: Four Sohei legends. Overwhelm or bind.

nodes.title: Volley Storm
nodes.speaker: Chrome Ashigaru
nodes.lore: Broadcast turns into a storm of chips. Ashigaru doctrine — hold the ring, spend the volley, refuse the hollow feed.
nodes.boardHint: Five enemies. Volleys and a Ronin legend.

nodes.title: Bindwall
nodes.speaker: Data Yamabushi
nodes.lore: Every retaliator is a trap. Yamabushi bind the wall so Works stays a place of making, not Null’s echo chamber.
nodes.boardHint: Binds plus legend pressure.

nodes.title: Synergy Tribunal
nodes.speaker: Kaizen Doctrine
nodes.lore: One board, five doctrines. Null Bloom tests whether your Captain reads tribe synergies — or fights as five strangers.
nodes.boardHint: All five tribes represented. Match their synergies.

nodes.title: Null Bloom Heart
nodes.speaker: Root Circuit
nodes.lore: The hollow core. Clear it and the Circuit stamps a batch of Wardens for the Blade Grove airdrop queue — playable now, claimable when mint opens. Pack Bay still sells foil acceleration; the war itself stays free.
nodes.boardHint: Capstone six. Bring your best board.
